name: Kirishima Kyouko
source:
Fighting Style: Kirishima family formula of Jiu Jitsu.
Birthplace / Origin: Kagoshima.
Occupation: Part-time worker.
Likes / Loves: Aromatherapy, herbal tea.

A member of one of the Masuda clan's branch families and [url=/c12667]Chiho[/url]'s distant cousin. She is sent to compete under orders to either force Chiho back into the clan or kill her.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable_Geo]Wikipedia[/url].]
